outcome.CombZ_wb: animal-level CombZ minus the mean of animal-level CombZ over the analysis population's animals in the same batch (one value per animal, not window-weighted; identical for POOL, F and M because Sex is nested in Batch)

position_change_rate.definition: canonical Stage 29 vendor-defined RFID position changes per observed hour; a position change is registered only when the vendor-estimated position moves >= 200 grid units (about two antenna spacings); the carried-forward vendor position persists until the next qualifying change; absence of a change means no sufficiently large relocation was registered, not complete bodily immobility

shared_position.definition: per animal: sum over tracked cage-mates of the time both animals simultaneously carry the same carried-forward vendor PositionID, divided by the time both are assigned (rfid_binfree_metrics.R:57-79); an assignment-based simultaneous co-occupancy, not raw antenna co-detection; not sociability, coordination or huddling
shared_position.rename: renamed from 'shared antenna-zone use' (Stage 29 config v1.0.0 label; renamed in config v1.0.1) because the metric uses the carried-forward vendor PositionID, not raw antenna identity; the code counts simultaneous time at the same position (rfid_binfree_metrics.R:57-79), hence 'occupancy' (decision 31)

fragmentation.definition: frozen Stage 29 definition (share of position-change bouts with exactly one change at bout_criterion_s = 39.397 s)

positional_inactivity_40.definition: per animal x canonical window: sum of the durations of canonical occupancy runs (intervals between consecutive canonical position-change events, same-PositionID runs merged; mmm_evs_window_stream) whose window-clipped duration is >= 40 s, divided by observed seconds obs_s
positional_inactivity_40.convention: an interval qualifying at >= 40 s counts in full (Pack 2007; Fisher 2012; McShane 2012; Keenan 2020); intervals are clipped to the analysis window first, then qualify; no bridging across the 06:30/18:30 boundaries; no recording interruptions or file ends inside the audited windows; the 12 zero-event light windows count (fraction 1)

windows.active: [anchor, anchor + 43,200 s), anchor = 18:30:00 logger clock on the cage-change day, observed from t0

positional_inactivity_40.interpretation: literature-motivated threshold; the signal detects absence of large positional relocation, not total bodily immobility; the canonical representation is much coarser than video/EEG immobility detection; absolute percentages are not estimates of physiological sleep duration

group_blind_qc.basis: 444 animal-windows per phase (all 111 RFID animals x CC1-CC4, all groups); rho_with_rate_BxCC = Spearman after Batch x CC centring; icc_after_rate = ICC1 by Batch x CC after a spline on the position-change rate (wfD/W1 w1_04_gate_values.csv, w1_04_reliability_rate_dependence.csv; wfD/X4 x4_01_gate_summary.csv)

cookie_response_60.interpretation: change in canonical home-cage locomotor activity from the hour immediately before to the hour after cookie presentation; a locomotor challenge-response phenotype; not cookie approach, proximity, investigation or consumption, and not a pure appetitive response (presentation/experimenter effects cannot be separated)
cookie_response_60.descriptive_disclosure: group-blind trace: low baseline, activity rises somewhat toward the end of PRE60 (particularly B4; cause not established by records), strong response after 17:00 peaking ~17:10-17:20, decay by ~17:45-18:00; descriptive only, not used for window choice
cookie_response_60.consumption: the experimenter's documented recollection (USER_DECISIONS_2026-09-29_round5.txt sections 10 and 17): the home-cage cookie was generally completely consumed within ~45-60 min; no removal was needed; no contemporaneous weighing or note is known; the B2 EPM+1 scored videos (a different test) are not evidence for this assay
cookie_response_60.precision: rates stored with 15 significant digits; exact rate = n_events x 3600 / obs_s (cookie_windows.csv); all 388 animal-windows fully observed (obs_s = window_s), position known at window start, seeded == unseeded

cookie_response_45.historical_convention: the historical MMManalyzer filter (CookieHab.R:30, TimeOnly >= '17:00' & <= '17:45') included the 17:45 minute, i.e. [17:00, 17:46) on 1-min vendor ActivityIndex rows; the Stage 30 sensitivity uses [17:00, 17:45) with the matched PRE45; the historical filter also required ConsecInactive == 2 (the session selector) and used vendor ActivityIndex (MMManalyzer Analysis/CookieHab.R:30, commit dacf5e9)

inference.CR2: m <- mmm_ci_fit(formula, data, id, engine = 'lm', expected_rank); focal <- mmm_ci_match(focal, names(coef(m$fit))); V <- clubSandwich::vcovCR(m$fit, cluster = m$data$CageEpisodeID, type = 'CR2'); ct <- clubSandwich::coef_test(m$fit, vcov = V, test = 'Satterthwaite', coefs = focal); p = p_Satt; 95% CI = beta +/- qt(0.975, df_Satt) x SE; OLS t (n - p df) reported alongside, descriptive only (E4 null size up to 0.31)
inference.KR: lmerTest::lmer REML (bobyqa, check.rankX = 'stop.deficient'); Kenward-Roger t (single term, mmm_ci_contrast) or joint F(3) (mmm_ci_joint); singular fits retained and flagged in every row (E4: unconditional size within [0.025, 0.075] for all 40 KR tests; conditional on fit state, singular fits are conservative and non-singular fits of near-boundary models liberal, e.g. SCREEN-L-SPO-POOL 0.094, SLEEP-CAT-IA40L-POOL 0.19); optimizer check as Stage 29: always for the (1 + cc1 || AnimalID) crossing-rate models (SCREEN-L-PCR-*), otherwise on any convergence warning; FAILED only if a convergence problem persists and the optimizers disagree
inference.failure_rule: an erroring or non-converged fit whose optimizers disagree is reported FAILED; a design that mmm_ci_fit refuses (rank < number of columns, or columns != expected_rank; mmm_ci_fit calls stop()) is caught by the driver and reported FAILED_RANK; both enter their local family and the global column with p = 1 (m unchanged); the driver never stops on a single hypothesis
inference.standardized_estimate: CONT: estimate x SD_x (POOL/F/M: slope of x; INT: x:sex_c coefficient); CAT: estimate / SD_y (g_RS or g_RS:sex_c); SD = sd(residuals of lm(variable ~ Batch)) in the hypothesis's own analysis population (n - 1 divisor); L: none (joint F); the three focal component estimates with KR SEs are reported
report_per_hypothesis: fit diagnostics (rank vs expected, singular, converged, optimizer agreement, failed)
design CR2 df vs expected_df_cr2 and LOW_DF label
LOBO: focal sign per refit and leverage batches (L: per component)
Movement-adjusted estimate and 95% CI (inactivity CONT/CAT) or joint KR F p (inactivity L)
POOL estimates reported separately and flagged ESTIMATION_ONLY
inference.null_calibration: pre-freeze group-blind calibration of all 64 registered tests with synthetic outcomes/labels on the real measurement data; results below and per hypothesis (calibration fields)
inference.design_gate: the driver stops before any outcome read if a CR2 hypothesis's design rank != expected_rank or |df_Satt - expected_df_cr2| > 1e-6; df_Satt depends only on X and the clusters (E1a/E4: spread 0 over 40,000 fits per test), so a mismatch means that the population, measure or cage metadata drifted; the gate also covers the CR2 POOL estimates (expected_df_cr2 in estimation_only.entries)
inference.low_df_rule: a CR2 row (primary or diagnostic) with df_Satt < 4 keeps its registered p and is labelled LOW_DF; the primary tests affected by design are SLEEP-CONT-IA40A-M (3.56) and SLEEP-CONT-IA40L-F (3.83), which are conservative under the E4 null (size 0.030 / 0.032; 0.023-0.061 over 4 scenarios); the COOKIE-CAT-DC60-M lm + CR2 diagnostic has df < 4 in 19.8% of random label draws

result_classification_rules.D_measurement_or_fit_limited: (i) an inactivity-block hypothesis with raw p < 0.05 whose Movement-adjusted model (sensitivities_estimation_only.inactivity[2]) gives a focal 95% CI including 0 (CONT/CAT), or a Movement-adjusted joint KR F p >= 0.05 (L) [reason D-MOVEMENT]; (ii) the primary fit is FAILED or FAILED_RANK [reason D-FIT]
result_classification_rules.A_robust_exploratory_signal: not D, AND local BH q < 0.05, AND the focal sign is the same in every leave-one-batch-out refit (L: the focal component with the largest |KR t| in the primary fit), AND no declared sensitivity of the hypothesis's block is labelled SIGN_CHANGE by mmm_ci_robust_label (L: on that same component)
result_classification_rules.B_suggestive: not D, not A, raw p < 0.05; reason B-MULT if local q >= 0.05 (multiplicity-negative), B-ROBUST if local q < 0.05 but the LOBO or SIGN_CHANGE criterion failed
result_classification_rules.C_clear_null: not D and raw p >= 0.05; described as 'no evidence of association at the registered test' with its CI, never as 'no effect'
result_classification_rules.global_q: reported for every hypothesis as context only (follow-up Q1)
result_classification_rules.wording: inactivity associations in D-MOVEMENT are never described as independent sleep biology; every light-phase inactivity row states that the metric is saturated (87% of light windows >= 0.99) and that inference rests on its lower tail; within-sex results are 'in females' / 'in males'; 'female-specific' / 'male-specific' only if the INT hypothesis of the same metric and question has local BH q < 0.05; POOL estimates are 'pooled across sexes (estimation only)', never 'in both sexes'
result_classification_rules.pool: POOL rows are ESTIMATION_ONLY and receive no classification

run_rules: run every registered hypothesis once; do not stop at a significant result
no new endpoints, windows, interactions, features or thresholds after outcome contact
families and inference fixed as registered

terminology.movement: RFID position-change rate (position changes/h); at first use 'vendor-defined RFID position changes requiring >= 200 grid units of displacement, about two antenna spacings'; never 'antenna crossing rate'
terminology.inactivity: RFID-defined sustained positional inactivity (>= 40 s); may be discussed as an RFID-derived sleep/inactivity proxy with the stated qualifications

sex_analyses.POOL: pooled SIS, model without any phenotype x sex term: ESTIMATION_ONLY (estimate, 95% CI, N, diagnostics); no p, no family, no classification (round-6 decision)
sex_analyses.M: within males only (cookie: B2 and B5 only, because B1 received no home-cage cookie)
sex_analyses.INT: pooled SIS, formal test that the association differs between the sexes
sex_analyses.rule: sex specificity is never inferred from separate F and M results; 'female-specific' / 'male-specific' wording requires the INT hypothesis of the same metric and question to have local BH q < 0.05
sex_analyses.discovery: F (within females), M (within males) and INT (formal sex-moderation test) are the discovery hypotheses in every metric x question cell

estimation_only.description: POOL (pooled SIS, no phenotype x sex term) for every metric x question cell: descriptive magnitude only; flagged ESTIMATION_ONLY in every output; no p-value, not in any local BH family, not in the global benchmark, no discovery classification
